correctness.rationale: Peter–Weyl reduces the mean-zero norm to the supremum of normalized SO(3) spin characters. The explicit spin-1,2,3 polynomials balance spins 1 and 3 at the unique solution (6c+1)^3=-35. Exact rational inequalities bound spin 2 and all spins >=4 strictly below rho; the four disjoint c-intervals prove sharpness and uniqueness including endpoints; k powers follow from selfadjoint central convolution. Independent SymPy algebra and numerical enclosures reproduced the main identities.
